svg.text: Wall geometry taken from the venue's blueprint · north is up (the venue's own drawings are turned 90°)
The arrival floor — check in here first

On the east side, with storage behind

A free-standing totem — place it wherever you like. No video.
Guests arrive from Bay Street or up the escalators
from the TD Concourse. Check in at the front desk,
leave coats on the east side, then take the Grand
